title: Bar Wall & Stone Backsplash Ideas | September 2025 GenStone Projects
description: See real GenStone bar wall and backsplash projects from September 2025. Explore creative stone ideas for kitchens, bars, and entertainment spaces.

We've Heard it All. What types of projects can GenStone be used for? GenStone is commonly used for: - Accent walls - Fireplace surrounds - Garage facades - Porch columns - Entryways - Outdoor kitchens - Basement feature walls The panels can be used anywhere you want the look of real stone without the weight or cost. Rob Dean Senior Project Coordinator Do GenStone panels require maintenance? GenStone requires very little maintenance. Most installations only need occasional cleaning with mild soap and water to remove dust or debris. Jagger Gottschalk Project Coordinator Do I need special tools to install GenStone panels? No special masonry tools are required. Most projects can be completed using common tools like a circular saw, screws, a drill, and a level. The panels are easy to cut and install using standard woodworking tools. Kevin O'Dwyer General Manager Can I install GenStone panels myself? Yes. GenStone panels are specifically designed for DIY installation. Many homeowners complete projects like accent walls, fireplaces, and garage facades without hiring a contractor.
